t: 迈赫迈德二世开始围攻君士坦丁堡. 该市于5月29日倒塌并更名为伊斯坦布尔.
te: Mehmed II begins his siege of Constantinople. The city falls on May 29 and is renamed Istanbul.
dz: 迈赫迈德二世开始围攻君士坦丁堡. 该市于5月29日倒塌并更名为伊斯坦布尔.
de: Mehmed II begins his siege of Constantinople. The city falls on May 29 and is renamed Istanbul.

t: 苏丹迈赫梅德二世手下的奥斯曼军队在经过了53天的围攻后占领了君士坦丁堡,结束了2000多年后的…
te: Ottoman armies under Sultan Mehmed II capture Constantinople after a 53-day siege, ending the Roman Empire after over 2…
dz: 君士坦丁堡陷落:苏丹迈赫梅德二世手下的奥斯曼军队在经过了53天的围攻后占领了君士坦丁堡,结束了2000多年后的罗马帝国.
de: Fall of Constantinople: Ottoman armies under Sultan Mehmed II capture Constantinople after a 53-day siege, ending the Roman Empire after over 2,000 years.

t: 百年战争中的最后一场战役,让分局所辖的法国人击败了在加斯科尼战役中被击毙的斯赫鲁斯伯里伯爵手下…
te: The last battle of the Hundred Years' War, the French under Jean Bureau defeat the English under the Earl of Shrewsbury…
dz: 卡斯蒂隆之战:百年战争中的最后一场战役,让分局所辖的法国人击败了在加斯科尼战役中被击毙的斯赫鲁斯伯里伯爵手下的英国人.
de: Battle of Castillon: The last battle of the Hundred Years' War, the French under Jean Bureau defeat the English under the Earl of Shrewsbury, who is killed in the battle in Gascony.

t: 卡斯蒂永战役三个月后，英国失去了在法国南部的最后一块领地。
te: Three months after the Battle of Castillon, England loses its last possessions in southern France.
dz: 百年战争：卡斯蒂永战役三个月后，英国失去了在法国南部的最后一块领地。
de: Hundred Years' War: Three months after the Battle of Castillon, England loses its last possessions in southern France.

t: 拉迪斯劳斯后宫被加冕为布拉格的波希米亚国王.
te: Ladislaus the Posthumous is crowned king of Bohemia in Prague.
dz: 拉迪斯劳斯后宫被加冕为布拉格的波希米亚国王.
de: Ladislaus the Posthumous is crowned king of Bohemia in Prague.
